config.collision_handling: soft exp(-distance_squared/collision_distance^2) repulsion plus separate distinct score
config.control_seeding: for each of 14 standard-compatible graphs only, optimizer start 0 of wave 0 is replaced by an aligned exact standard-18 realization
config.cpu_refinement: top-k distinct MPS endpoints per graph; SciPy float64 LM with exact analytic Jacobian and a zero-outside-radius distance collision hinge
config.dtype: torch.float32 on accelerator; candidate refinement uses NumPy/SciPy float64
config.gauge: lexicographically first K7 when present, otherwise first K6; K6 frame is the first six vertices of the fixed regular K7 simplex
config.initialization: each outside vertex sampled exactly on the common unit sphere of its fixed-simplex neighbours
config.optimizer: PyTorch Adam with cosine learning-rate decay
config.semantics: HEURISTIC_ONLY; no numerical rejection or realizability conclusion

trust.collision_bias: soft repulsion may miss genuine near-collision realizations
trust.floating_point: PyTorch/MPS float32 and optional SciPy float64; no rigorous rounding claim
trust.nonedges: unconstrained and may also be unit
trust.optimizer: failure to find a solution has no mathematical meaning
